definitions.explanation: The cancellation of a scheduled flight, ship, or other transportation service, typically due to weather or other conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{欠航|けっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{欠航|けっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be cancelled due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{欠航|けっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The flight was cancelled due to the blizzard.

notes:
{欠航|けっこう} means the cancellation of a scheduled flight, ferry, or other transportation service. Usually caused by weather (typhoons, snow, fog) or mechanical issues.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {欠航|けっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be cancelled (intransitive)
- {欠航|けっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cancel service
- {欠航|けっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧: cancellations pile up one after another

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠航|けっこう}⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧: cancelled flight
- {欠航|けっこう}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: cancellation information
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{欠航|けっこう}: cancelled due to typhoon

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with:
- ⟦{決行|けっこう}→決行：02794_kekkou⟧: to carry out, proceed (despite obstacles)
- ⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧: quite; fine; no thank you

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{運休|うんきゅう}→運休：06807_unkyuu⟧: service suspension (mainly for trains/buses)
- ⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧: delay
